lessons.source: current owner instruction + repository private continuity contract
lessons.trigger: A fresh auditor needs exact private reads while the app needs mutations.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Keep InnerSignal Private Continuity read-only and implement mutations in a separate backend/controller boundary with write/audit scopes.
lessons.failureCondition: The continuity MCP advertises or executes a write, or the writer bypasses case-scoped authorization.
lessons.repairAction: Remove the mutation from continuity and route it through the separate authorized controller.

lessons.trigger: A supplied completion changes the effective meaning of a previously truncated raw turn.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Preserve the raw turn exactly, append an immutable completion source artifact and amendment with exact source range/context provenance, and derive the effective view.
lessons.failureCondition: The raw turn changes, the completion lacks provenance, or a downstream handoff omits the amendment/effective distinction.
lessons.repairAction: Restore the original bytes and rebuild the effective view from the append-only amendment.

lessons.trigger: A candidate is failed, reconstructed, audited, approved, or sent.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Bind audit evidence to exact immutable candidate bytes/version and mechanically reject producer-context certification of that version.
lessons.failureCondition: A stale audit or producer session can approve changed bytes.
lessons.repairAction: Block delivery, restore pending-audit state, and require a fresh session to audit the exact version.

lessons.source: current owner instruction + PR 49 lifecycle authority
lessons.trigger: A substantive audit finding causes reconstruction.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Create an immutable child, require all repair-induced-error checks on its fresh audit, and reject a third repair cycle.
lessons.failureCondition: Approval is inherited, repair-induced checks are absent, or repair_cycle exceeds two.
lessons.repairAction: Invalidate the transition and route to fresh audit or DISCRIMINATE_OR_BLOCK.

lessons.trigger: The real completion, audit, candidate, and case state are private while the repository is public.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Keep real payloads and private-derived hashes in mode-0600 files/encrypted storage outside the checkout; commit only generic/synthetic material and safe opaque IDs.
lessons.failureCondition: Tracked files, Git metadata, PR text, CI, or terminal receipts expose private content or a private-derived digest.
lessons.repairAction: Block push, remove the disclosure from candidate history, and rerun publication audits.

lessons.trigger: The amended transcript and v2 are projected into a new immutable handoff.
lessons.requiredBehavior: Preserve raw transcript, amendment provenance, effective transcript, v1 failed audit, v2 lineage/status, and distinct handoff/audit gates with zero unexplained delta.
lessons.failureCondition: The handoff rewrites history, omits v2, loses the failed audit, or presents v2 as approved.
lessons.repairAction: Reject the handoff and compile a new immutable version from the canonical encrypted record.

Repository authority, current checkpoint, active lock, continuity/storage/access/audit/handoff code, tests, current audit conversation, and the relevant live universal patterns were inspected.
The owner explicitly authorized the private source amendment, failed-audit persistence, v2 reconstruction, and GitHub update while forbidding v2 approval and public case material.
